name: Passage of Arms
description: An area of land has been granted protection, reducing damage taken for all who enter.
effects: An area of land has been granted protection, reducing damage taken for all who enter.

source_abilities.name: Passage of Arms
source_abilities.description:
Increases block rate to 100% and creates a designated area in a cone behind you in which party members will only suffer 85% of all damage inflicted.
Duration: 18s
Effect ends upon using another action or moving (including facing a different direction).
Cancels auto-attack upon execution.
